C0957.title: Nineteen Prosecuted in Case Involving Unregistered SIM Cards, Offline and Online Real-Name Activation, and SIM Banks
C0957.summary: On February 24, 2023, People's Daily Online reported that prosecutors in Jurong, Jiangsu charged 19 defendants with infringing citizens' personal information. The case involved selling unregistered SIM cards, activating real-name cards through offline and online promotion, and connecting cards to SIM bank and code-receiving platforms to supply verification-code and account-registration resources to downstream black-market operators.

references.title: Illegal Sale of 'Blank SIM Cards,' Offline and Online Real-Name Activation, and SIM Bank Authentication: Nineteen Prosecuted for Infringing Citizens' Personal Information
